scope: Four readers, two updates, and two delete/purge operations released together from an IPC barrier; disjoint mutation IDs, one strict disk authority.
limitations: Local synthetic workload; not cross-platform admission, native IDE Stop, crash recovery, or sustained production throughput.
Read requests each capture one generation; concurrent cursors are not reused across changing generations.
Timing includes process IPC and shutdown after the ready barrier; fixture construction and final full audit are outside it.
